title: Autofill Check
summary: Highlights fields that the browser or password manager autofilled and flags values that look wrong, like an email in the Name field.
description: Detects autofill (the :autofill animationstart hook plus a no-typing batch heuristic), outlines and lists filled fields for review, flags an email in Name or a value that differs from the account with a one-tap fix, and holds the first submit.
catches: Fields filled without typing, detected by the :autofill hook or a timing heuristic
Values that do not fit the field (an email in Name, a number in Email)
Values that differ from what the account already holds (an old address), with a one-tap replacement
The same value filled into two different fields
limits: Detection is heuristic; some password managers and browsers fill in ways it cannot see, and fast pasting can look like autofill
Field types are guessed from autocomplete, type and name attributes
The first submit is held only once; the second goes through
a11y: Review banner is aria-live="polite" and becomes role="alert" when a submit is held
A held submit moves focus to the first suspect field; list entries focus their field
Field names in the list come from their <label> or aria-label
stops: Autofill put email in name field
